      "title": "Existing custom grant factories now prevent server startup",
      "body": "The new abstract getShortcut() method is invoked on every registered grant factory by DefaultTokenContextEncoderProviderFactory.postInit().       "title": "The access-token matcher does not check the expected grant",
      "body": "Grant shortcuts occupy indexes 4 through 5, but the matcher reads substring(3, 5) and rejects equality rather than inequality. For example, an onrtro:<UUID> token passes when the expected grant is ac. Consequently, the authorization-code, device, CIBA, and refresh event tests accept missing or incorrect grant metadata. Check the prefix length, extract substring(4, 6), and reject mismatches."
    },

      "file": "services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/protocol/oidc/encode/DefaultTokenContextEncoderProviderFactory.java",
      "line": 74,
      "severity": "medium",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "Accepted grant shortcuts can produce undecodable token IDs",
      "body": "Grant shortcuts are registered without checking their length, while OAuth2GrantTypeFactory.getShortcut() documents a three-letter shortcut. A custom grant following that documentation produces IDs such as onrtabc:<UUID>, but getTokenContextFromTokenId() requires exactly six context characters and rejects every such ID. Specify and validate the two-character requirement before accepting a factory so the encoder cannot emit IDs its decoder rejects."
    },

      "file": "services/src/test/java/org/keycloak/protocol/oidc/encode/DefaultTokenContextEncoderProviderTest.java",

      "title": "The invalid-grant test passes on an unintended NullPointerException",
      "body": "The test setup never calls factory.postInit() or supplies a sessionFactory. Looking up the unregistered ac shortcut therefore enters getGrantTypeByShortcut()'s fallback and throws NullPointerException when accessing sessionFactory. Catching any RuntimeException makes the test pass without reaching the decoder's intended IllegalArgumentException. Initialize or mock the factory lookup and assert the specific expected exception."
    },

      "file": "services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/protocol/oidc/encode/AccessTokenContext.java",

      "title": "The raw token ID null check validates the wrong argument",
      "body": "The check labeled \"Null rawTokenId not allowed\" checks grantType a second time instead of rawTokenId. A context with a null raw ID is therefore accepted, and encodeTokenId() emits the literal suffix ':null' rather than rejecting the invalid identifier. Validate rawTokenId here to enforce the constructor's intended invariant."

findings.title: Existing custom grant factories now prevent server startup
findings.body: The new abstract getShortcut() method is invoked on every registered grant factory by DefaultTokenContextEncoderProviderFactory.postInit(). Custom grant factories compiled against the previous interface have no implementation, so startup throws AbstractMethodError, even if their grant is never requested. Provide a compatibility path for existing factories, or explicitly document the required provider migration.

findings.title: The access-token matcher does not check the expected grant
findings.body: Grant shortcuts occupy indexes 4 through 5, but the matcher reads substring(3, 5) and rejects equality rather than inequality. For example, an onrtro:<UUID> token passes when the expected grant is ac. Consequently, the authorization-code, device, CIBA, and refresh event tests accept missing or incorrect grant metadata. Check the prefix length, extract substring(4, 6), and reject mismatches.

findings.title: Accepted grant shortcuts can produce undecodable token IDs
findings.body: Grant shortcuts are registered without checking their length, while OAuth2GrantTypeFactory.getShortcut() documents a three-letter shortcut. A custom grant following that documentation produces IDs such as onrtabc:<UUID>, but getTokenContextFromTokenId() requires exactly six context characters and rejects every such ID. Specify and validate the two-character requirement before accepting a factory so the encoder cannot emit IDs its decoder rejects.

findings.title: The invalid-grant test passes on an unintended NullPointerException
findings.body: The test setup never calls factory.postInit() or supplies a sessionFactory. Looking up the unregistered ac shortcut therefore enters getGrantTypeByShortcut()'s fallback and throws NullPointerException when accessing sessionFactory. Catching any RuntimeException makes the test pass without reaching the decoder's intended IllegalArgumentException. Initialize or mock the factory lookup and assert the specific expected exception.

findings.title: The raw token ID null check validates the wrong argument
findings.body: The check labeled "Null rawTokenId not allowed" checks grantType a second time instead of rawTokenId. A context with a null raw ID is therefore accepted, and encodeTokenId() emits the literal suffix ':null' rather than rejecting the invalid identifier. Validate rawTokenId here to enforce the constructor's intended invariant.
